title: Tverberg theory
description: Partitions, convex hulls, and intersection patterns. Colorful, tolerant, quantitative, and topological versions of Tverberg’s theorem.

title: Mass partitions
description: Fairly dividing measures using hyperplanes and other geometric shapes, with connections to topology and convexity.

title: Helly-type theorems
description: How local intersection conditions force global conclusions. Colorful, fractional, and quantitative forms of Helly’s theorem.

title: Topological combinatorics
description: Using topology to organize combinatorial choices: Borsuk–Ulam and KKM theorems, selection structures, and configuration spaces.

title: Combinatorial convexity
description: Transversals, quantitative intersection theorems, convex sets, and geometric depth.

title: Graph theory
description: Graph homomorphisms, partition functions, geometric graphs, and crossing numbers.

title: Fair division
description: Envy-free partitions and fair allocations, studied through geometric and topological methods.

title: Discrepancy & tolerance
description: Connections between discrepancy, probabilistic methods, and geometric partitions that tolerate deletions.

title: Polytopes & symmetry
description: Realizing prescribed symmetry groups and automorphisms in convex polytopes.
